# Purpose
`test_sysvar_cache_util.h` defines a small test support interface for creating and destroying a sysvar cache environment. It declares the `test_sysvar_cache_env` structure, which stores the workspace state, database handle, transaction ID, bank pointer, and sysvar cache pointer needed for the test setup. The file also declares [`test_sysvar_cache_env_create`](<#test_sysvar_cache_env_create>) and [`test_sysvar_cache_env_destroy`](<#test_sysvar_cache_env_destroy>), which allocate and release the temporary runtime objects used by the tests.
